upsertPapers.title: Online Algorithms for Geometric Independent Set

upsertSlices.label: Online maximum independent set
upsertSlices.task: Irrevocable vertex decisions; competitive cardinality under bounded neighborhood independence.
assumptions: Competitive ratio OPT/E[ALG] uses symbolic ζ-dependent categories. ζ is the maximum independent-set size inside one neighborhood; no geometric representation is assumed.

axis.label: See scoped figure panels; incompatible objectives have separate axes

results.notes: The same greedy output is maximal; this panel measures its size against maximum optimum.
Do not interpret this ratio lower bound as a lower bound on the effort needed to maintain maximality.
The ζ-dependent formulas are categorical anchors, not fixed numerical ratios.
